{'text': 'WhatsApp 用戶現在可以邀請其他人加入群組通話及一對一通話，即使對方未有帳戶亦無問題。以下是詳細內容。', 'paragraph_context': 'WhatsApp users can now invite others to join group and one-on-one calls even if they don’t have an account. Here are the details.'}

{'text': '「為所有人提供免費、無時間限制的端對端加密通話」', 'paragraph_context': '’Free, end-to-end encrypted calls for everyone with no time limits’'}

{'text': 'WhatsApp 今日宣布正式推出「訪客通話」（guest calling）功能，讓用戶可以「邀請任何人加入 WhatsApp 通話——即使對方並無 WhatsApp 帳戶」。', 'paragraph_context': 'Today, WhatsApp announced the official rollout of guest calling, a feature that lets users "invite anyone to join a WhatsApp call – even if they don\'t have a WhatsApp account."'}

{'text': 'WhatsApp 表示，無論是一對一通話，還是容納多達 32 人參與的群組通話，訪客在加入前必須先獲得通話主持人的批准。', 'paragraph_context': 'According to WhatsApp, guests must always be approved by the call host before joining, whether it’s a one-on-one call or a group call with up to 32 participants.'}

{'text': '訪客需先進入等候室，待批准後方可加入，主持人亦可隨時將其移除。此外，訪客無法查看其他與會者的電話號碼、發送訊息或邀請其他人加入。', 'paragraph_context': 'Guests enter a waiting room before being admitted, and hosts can remove them at any time. Guests also cannot see other participants’ phone numbers, send messages, or invite additional people.'}

{'text': 'WhatsApp 表示，訪客通話支援螢幕共享、舉手發言及表情符號反應等功能。訪客亦可直接從電腦瀏覽器加入通話，無需安裝應用程式。', 'paragraph_context': 'WhatsApp says guest calling supports features such as screen sharing, hand-raising, and emoji-based reactions. Guests can also join directly from a computer browser, without installing the app.'}

{'text': '以下是 WhatsApp 對這項新功能的介紹：', 'paragraph_context': 'Here’s WhatsApp on the new feature:'}

{'text': '要開始使用，只需進入 WhatsApp 的「通話」分頁，點選「+」圖示，建立通話連結，再傳送給你想聯絡的人——無論是同事、同學或導師——毋須擔心對方使用甚麼應用程式。', 'paragraph_context': 'To get started, navigate to the Calls tab in WhatsApp, select the “+” icon, create a call link, and send it to the people you want to talk to – colleagues, classmates, or tutor – without having to worry about what apps they have.'}

{'text': '今次推出功能前，WhatsApp 早前已擴大測試類似的文字對話功能，讓用戶可與沒有 WhatsApp 帳戶的人互傳端對端加密訊息。不過當時該功能並不支援語音或視像通話。', 'paragraph_context': 'Today’s launch comes after WhatsApp expanded testing of a similar feature for text conversations earlier this year, allowing users to exchange end-to-end encrypted messages with people who don’t have a WhatsApp account. At the time, however, the feature didn’t support voice or video calls.'}

{'text': '說回今日的消息，WhatsApp 亦宣布正與 Google Calendar 及 Outlook 進行整合，用戶將可直接從日曆建立 WhatsApp 通話連結，並加入活動邀請中。該功能需要安裝 WhatsApp 插件，預計今年稍後時間推出。', 'paragraph_context': 'Back to today’s news, WhatsApp also announced it is working on integrations with Google Calendar and Outlook, which will allow users to create WhatsApp call links directly from their calendars and add them to event invitations. The feature will require a WhatsApp plugin and is expected to launch later this year.'}
